sources.facts: Heritage agency text: Scottish Baronial house/Neo-Gothic tower; colonial two-storey verandas round three sides; separate attached ballroom wing (1887); local basalt/limestone trim and sandstone ballroom. Descriptive factual support only; no protected photographs/plans adopted.
1966 government encyclopedia gives ballroom90x30ft (27.432x9.144m), approximate interior factual dimensions; do not replace whole native exterior footprint or treat as current surveyed roof profile.
